overview:
**Fire danger is High today, driven by dry fuels—ERC at 82% and 1000-hr fuels at just 14%.**
- Danger climbs to Very High by Friday, Aug. 29, before easing back to High through the weekend.
- Warm, breezy NE winds (8–12 mph) and low afternoon humidity (21–27%) will keep fuels receptive to ignition.
- No Red Flag Warning is posted; 0 of 7 local watchout thresholds are currently met.
- Stage 2 fire restrictions remain in effect for Montrose County, Gunnison County, and Ouray County—no open burning or campfires.
- Nearby: the Elk Fire, 7 miles NW of Lake City, is 7,257 acres and 33% contained; the Gold Mountain Fire north of Ouray is 39,718 acres and 87% contained.
